table.name: Addresses
table.purpose: Postal addresses, referenced by Students for permanent and current address. Data appears synthetic (random city/country/state combinations).

address_id.name: address_id
address_id.description: Primary key of the address record.

line_1.name: line_1
line_1.description: First street address line (street number, street name, optionally unit).

line_2.name: line_2
line_2.description: Second address line, typically apartment or suite number.

state_province_county.name: state_province_county
state_province_county.description: State/province/county of the address; values are mostly US state names (some concatenated like 'SouthDakota').

zip_postcode.name: zip_postcode
zip_postcode.description: Postal/ZIP code; stored as text, values are 3-digit numbers (synthetic data).

table.name: Courses
table.purpose: Catalog of courses offered (e.g. math, nlp, os, db).

course_description.name: course_description
course_description.description: Short description code of the course; values are single letters (placeholder/synthetic data), so the actual descriptive meaning is not recoverable. Could also be a course abbreviation or category code.

course_name.name: course_name
course_name.description: Course name/short code (e.g. math, nlp, os, db).

degree_program_id.name: degree_program_id
degree_program_id.description: Primary key of the degree program.

degree_summary_description.name: degree_summary_description
degree_summary_description.description: Description of the degree program; values are Latin-like filler words (synthetic), so no real meaning. Could also be a summary of program requirements rather than a free-text description.

degree_summary_name.name: degree_summary_name
degree_summary_name.description: Degree level: Bachelor, Master, or PHD.

department_id.name: department_id
department_id.description: Foreign key to Departments.department_id — the department offering the program.

table.name: Departments
table.purpose: Academic departments (e.g. math, history, computer science).

department_description.name: department_description
department_description.description: Description of the department; values are Latin-like filler words (synthetic), so no real meaning. Could also be a mission statement or overview text rather than a short description.

department_name.name: department_name
department_name.description: Department name (e.g. math, history, computer science).

table.name: Sections
table.purpose: Sections (offerings) of courses; each section belongs to one course.

course_id.name: course_id
course_id.description: Foreign key to Courses.course_id — the course this section belongs to.

section_description.name: section_description
section_description.description: Description of the section; values are Latin-like filler words (synthetic), so no real meaning. Could also describe schedule or location details of the section rather than its content.

section_name.name: section_name
section_name.description: Section identifier/label, single letters a–p (like section 'A', 'B', ...).

semester_description.name: semester_description
semester_description.description: Short description code of the semester; single letters (placeholder data), actual meaning not recoverable. Could also be a semester abbreviation or term code.

table.name: Student_Enrolment
table.purpose: Enrolment of a student in a degree program during a specific semester; links Students, Degree_Programs and Semesters.

degree_program_id.name: degree_program_id
degree_program_id.description: Foreign key to Degree_Programs.degree_program_id — the program the student is enrolled in.

semester_id.name: semester_id
semester_id.description: Foreign key to Semesters.semester_id — the semester of the enrolment.

student_enrolment_id.name: student_enrolment_id
student_enrolment_id.description: Primary key of the enrolment record.

student_id.name: student_id
student_id.description: Foreign key to Students.student_id — the enrolled student.

table.name: Student_Enrolment_Courses
table.purpose: Courses taken within a student's enrolment; links an enrolment to a course (junction between Student_Enrolment and Courses).

course_id.name: course_id
course_id.description: Foreign key to Courses.course_id — the course taken.

student_course_id.name: student_course_id
student_course_id.description: Primary key of the student-course record; values are a mix of small integers and large numbers (synthetic data).

student_enrolment_id.name: student_enrolment_id
student_enrolment_id.description: Foreign key to Student_Enrolment.student_enrolment_id — the enrolment this course belongs to.

table.name: Students
table.purpose: One row per student: personal identity, contact details, registration dates, and links to current and permanent addresses. Referenced by Student_Enrolment.

cell_mobile_number.name: mobile phone number
cell_mobile_number.description: Student's mobile phone number, stored in inconsistent formats (with/without country code, parentheses, dots, extensions).

current_address_id.name: current address
current_address_id.description: Foreign key to Addresses.address_id; the student's current (residential) address.

date_first_registered.name: first registration date
date_first_registered.description: Timestamp when the student first registered. Values span 1971-2018; the data appears synthetic/randomized.

date_left.name: date left
date_left.description: Timestamp when the student left the institution. Note: in the sample data it can precede date_first_registered, so the values are not internally consistent.

email_address.name: email address
email_address.description: Student's email address; unique per row, example.org/net/com domains.

permanent_address_id.name: permanent address
permanent_address_id.description: Foreign key to Addresses.address_id; the student's permanent (home) address.

ssn.name: social security number
ssn.description: Student's social security number stored as text. Values are inconsistent (empty string, 1-9 digit numbers), suggesting dirty or synthetic data; treat as text, not numeric. Alternative reading: a generic student ID number, but SSN remains the most plausible meaning.

student_id.name: student ID
student_id.description: Primary key of the Students table; unique identifier for each student, referenced by Student_Enrolment.student_id.

table.name: Transcript_Contents
table.purpose: Junction/line-item table linking transcripts to the student-course enrolments they contain: each row says a given student_course_id appears on a given transcript.

student_course_id.name: student course enrolment
student_course_id.description: Foreign key to Student_Enrolment_Courses.student_course_id; identifies the course enrolment record listed on the transcript. Values are inconsistent (0, small ints, and large ids), suggesting dirty data.

transcript_id.name: transcript
transcript_id.description: Foreign key to Transcripts.transcript_id; the transcript this line item belongs to.

table.name: Transcripts
table.purpose: One row per transcript issued to a student, with its issue date; its contents (course entries) are listed in Transcript_Contents.

transcript_date.name: transcript date
transcript_date.description: Timestamp when the transcript was issued/produced. Values span 1975-2013 (appear synthetic).

transcript_id.name: transcript ID
transcript_id.description: Primary key of the Transcripts table; referenced by Transcript_Contents.transcript_id.
